consultation.name: Consultation
consultation.desc: General and follow-up consultations with our doctors, same-day appointments.

ultrasound.name: Ultrasound
ultrasound.desc: Obstetric and abdominal scans, with a printed report for your doctor.

nursing.name: Nursing care
nursing.desc: Injections, dressings, vitals and short-stay observation beds.

surgery.name: Minor surgery

circ.name: Circumcision
circ.desc: Safe, hygienic procedures for boys and men with follow-up visits included.

fp.name: Family planning
fp.desc: Confidential counselling and the full range of modern methods.

hiv.name: HIV testing & vaccination

doctors.title: Find a doctor and see when they are free
doctors.lead: Every doctor's calendar is public for the next seven days, in every service category. Pick a free time and reception confirms it with you.
doctors.legend: Numbers are free slots that day ·

services.title: What we offer
services.lead: Nine service lines under one roof, so most visits are completed the same day. Sample prices shown; the receptionist confirms your insurer's rate.

book.title: Book a visit in three steps
book.lead: Walk-ins are always welcome. Booking ahead shortens your wait and lets the doctor prepare your file.
book.step1: WhatsApp or SMS your name, the service you need and a preferred day and time — or call reception.
book.step2: Within the hour during opening times you receive a confirmation with your appointment time and doctor.
book.step3: Bring your national ID and insurance card. You get a ticket number and the screen shows when it is your turn.
book.emergency: Not for emergencies. If someone is in danger call 912 (SAMU) or come straight to the clinic.
book.sent: Request sent. Reception will confirm by {{channel}} within the hour during opening times.
book.sentRef: Request {{ref}} sent. Reception will confirm by {{channel}} within the hour during opening times.
book.sendFailed: The request could not be sent. Check your connection or call reception.

insurance.title: Insurance we accept
insurance.lead: Bring your card and ID; we bill your insurer directly and you pay only your share at the cashier — cash, MTN MoMo, Airtel Money, card or bank.
